_description: ILLUSTRATIVE template only. Replace values locally with owner-supplied data; do not upload confidential data to the hosted demo.

_field_descriptions.annual_noi: Required; year-one NOI in USD/year; strictly greater than 0.
_field_descriptions.annual_noi_growth: Decimal percentage, e.g. 0.03 for 3%; must be >= -1.
_field_descriptions.exit_cap_rate: Decimal percentage, e.g. 0.06 for 6%; must be > 0.
_field_descriptions.discount_rate: Decimal percentage used for NPV, e.g. 0.10; must be >= 0.
_field_descriptions.acquisition_cost_pct: Decimal percentage of purchase price, e.g. 0.03; range 0 to 1.
_field_descriptions.selling_cost_pct: Decimal percentage of exit value, e.g. 0.02; range 0 to 1.
_field_descriptions.leverage: Decimal percentage of purchase price, e.g. 0.50; range 0 to less than 1.
_field_descriptions.debt_rate: Decimal annual debt rate, e.g. 0.06; must be >= 0.
_field_descriptions.verified_by: Optional reviewer name; leave blank until owner supplies it.
_field_descriptions.source_reference: Optional source-document reference; leave blank until owner supplies it.
_field_descriptions.source_status: Use REVIEW REQUIRED until verified_by and source_reference are both non-empty.
